title: KK - 64737 Gårdsveien 1, tilbygg
description: Kristiansund kommune v/ Eiendomsdrift skal lage et tilbygg til bolig i Gårdsveien 1. Tilbygget består av to soverom og en stue. Det skal dessuten skiftes vinduer og bordkledning på en vegg, samt skifte ut noen vindskibord. Denne anskaffelsen gjelder oppsetting av tilbygget, nødvendig grunnarbeid, utskifting av vinduer og en balkongdør, og annet bygningsmessige arbeider, samt arbeid innen tekniske fagområder i denne sammenheng. Bygget ble oppført rundt år 2004. Kristiansund kommune vil bestille rammeavtaleaktører på tekniske fag som vil bli kontrahert for seg. Dette gjelder Malerarbeider, gulvbelegg, Elektro, ventilasjon og evt. rør og sanitær. Det forventes at tømrerfaget tar med seg nødvendige underentreprenører i sitt tilbud som: · Grunnentreprenør · Murer- Støping såle/grunnmur/plate. · Blikkenslager ved behov · Evt andre fag for komplett leveranse. Tømrerfaget/tilbyder tar det overordnede koordineringsansvaret under utførelsesarbeidene, også opp mot de tekniske fagene, og dette skal være inkludert i tilbudet. Tiltakene skal gjennomføres samtidig som beboerne bor i boligen, noe som stiller særskilte krav til planlegging, koordinering, avgrensing av arbeidsområder, renhold og støyhåndtering. Entreprenør må regne med tett dialog med byggherre for å ivareta HMS og logistikk gjennom hele prosjektet.

title: Netherlands – Construction work – Partnerselectie EHAD-terrein Helmond
description: De gemeente, woCom en Woonpartners zijn voor het EHAD-terrein op zoek naar een gebiedsontwikkelaar. Dat wil zeggen een partij, die de complexiteit van de opgave overziet, de ambities voor het EHAD-terrein omarmt en deelt, ervaring heeft met soortgelijke opgaven, langjarig commitment toont en zich hiermee ook langjarig als samenwerkingspartner wil binden aan de opgave. Op basis hiervan hebben de gemeente en de woningcorporaties samengevat het volgende ultieme doel geformuleerd voor deze partnerselectieprocedure: “Het selecteren van een gebiedsontwikkelaar, die voor het EHAD-terrein maximale invulling geeft aan de vijf thema’s uit de Visie Stationskwartier Helmond en zich langjarig committeert aan het gebied in een samenwerking met de gemeente Helmond, woCom en Woonpartners.” De totale bruto vloeroppervlakte van de woonfuncties mag niet meer bedragen dan 50.000 m2 en in aantal maximaal 520 woningen. Het aantal vierkante meters aan niet-woonfuncties (exclusief parkeren) mag niet meer bedragen dan 20.750 m2, als volgt verdeeld: • 16.000 m2 bruto vloeroppervlakte voor bedrijven in de milieucategorie I en II. (definitie passend in/naast/bij woningen); • 3.000 m2 bruto vloeroppervlak voor maatschappelijk (geen zeer kwetsbare groepen); • 1.500 m2 bruto vloeroppervlak voor detailhandel (maximaal 250 m2 bruto vloeroppervlak voor een supermarkt); • 750 m2 bruto vloeroppervlak voor horeca I in minstens twee gebouwen. Het bewoners- en bezoekers parkeren voor alle woningen en alle overige niet-woonfuncties is voorzien in de op het EHAD-terrein te realiseren parkeerhub.

De initiële opdracht omvat fase 1 en 2. De vervolgfasen voor het Definitief Ontwerp, de contract- en aanbestedingsdocumenten en de begeleiding van de aanbesteding voor de realisatie kunnen als opties worden opgedragen. De opdracht omvat ingenieurs- en adviesdiensten voor het Fietsecoduct A13 en wordt gefaseerd uitgevoerd. De initiële opdracht bestaat uit fase 1 (herijking van het Programma van Eisen en de projectrandvoorwaarden) en fase 2 (uitwerking van het Voorlopig Ontwerp). Daarnaast omvat de aanbesteding mogelijke vervolgfasen: fase 3 (Definitief Ontwerp), fase 4 (opstellen van contract- en aanbestedingsdocumenten) en fase 5 (begeleiding van de aanbesteding voor de realisatie). De opdracht omvat onder meer ontwerp- en advieswerkzaamheden, technische en specialistische onderzoeken, kostenramingen, risicobeheersing, vergunningen en afstemming met Rijkswaterstaat en andere stakeholders. De omvang van de werkzaamheden is nader uitgewerkt in de aanbestedingsleidraad en de bijbehorende bijlagen. Uitsluitend fase 1 en fase 2 worden bij aanvang opgedragen. Opdrachtverlening voor de vervolgfasen is optioneel en afhankelijk van afzonderlijke besluitvorming door de opdrachtgevers.

title: Finland – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – SATKAT-järjestelmä
description: Puolustusvoimien logistiikkalaitos (jäljempänä Hankintayksikkö) pyytää osallistumishakemustanne SATKAT-järjestelmän hankintaan Puolustusvoimille tämän osallistumishakemuspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Hankinnan kohteena on avaruustilannekuvan SATKAT-tietojärjestelmä. SATKAT-järjestelmään poimitaan tietoja ja siirretään implementoitavan yhdyskäytävän läpi SATKAT-järjestelmän satelliittikatalogiin. Keskeisimmät järjestelmän käyttötapaukset on kuvattu liitteessä 4. Se sisältää tarjouspyynnössä vaadittavan, tarjouspyyntövaiheessa tarjoajan toteuttaman käyttötapausten demonstroinnin ja metodologian sekä pisteytyksen kuvauksen. Dokumentti saatetaan tiedoksi osallistumishakemusvaiheessa tarkoituksena tarjota yrityksille tietoa tulevan tarjouspyynnön keskeisestä sisällöstä eikä liitteessä 4 vaadittuja dokumentteja tarvitse toimittaa osallistumishakemuksen liitteenä. Se mahdollistaa yritysten valmistautumisen teknisesti vaativan järjestelmän tarjoamiseen antamalla tietoa resurssien, potentiaalisten kumppanuus- ja tuotetarpeiden sekä innovatiivisten ratkaisujen alustavaan analysointiin. Hankinnan kohteen tekninen määrittely ja tuoterakenne esitetään tarjouspyynnössä. Hankinnan kohteena on SATKAT-järjestelmä, jonka toimitus koostuu seuraavista kokonaisuuksista 1. Satelliittikatalogin tuottaminen 2. Järjestelmän ohjelmistojen tuottaminen a. Satelliittikatalogin ylläpidon ja käytön ohjelmistot b. Tilannekuvatuotteiden generoinnin ohjelmistot c. Astrodynamiikan laskentamoottori tilannekuvatuotteiden generointia varten d. Astrodynamiikan analyysiohjelmisto e. Astrodynamiikan katseluohjelmisto f. Ohjelmointirajapinnan (API) tuottaminen (tietojen vienti katalogiin) 3. Yhdyskäytävään liittyvä määrittely- ja toteutustyö tarjouspyynnössä kuvattavalla tavalla. 4. Ohjelmistotuotteiden käyttöoikeus 5. Järjestelmän testaus- ja koulutustuki 6. Järjestelmän dokumentaation tuottaminen 7. Järjestelmän koulutus 6. Järjestelmän tuki- ja huolto Toimitus tulee sisältämään teknisen järjestelmän, sen asennuksen, integraation, testauksen ja hyväksynnän, dokumentoinnin ja koulutuksen sekä tuen ja osallistumisen järjestelmän asennuksiin laboratorio-, tuotantotestaus- ja operatiiviseen ympäristöön. Toimittaja tuottaa Hankintasopimuksen mukaiset palvelut ensisijaisesti suomen kielellä. Mikäli työ edellyttää työskentelyä puolustusvoimien tiloissa, Ehdokas sitoutuu tuottamaan palvelut puolustusvoimien osoittamissa tiloissa Suomessa. Varsinaisten työskentelytilojen lisäksi ehdokas suostuu tuottamaan palveluita myös muissa puolustusvoimien tiloissa Suomessa, mikäli Puolustusvoimat sitä edellyttää. title: Ireland – Remote-control equipment – CFT for the supply of Multi Modal ROV (and Accessories)

title: Finland – Digital mapping services – Sotilasilmailukarttatuotanto
description: Puolustusvoimien logistiikkalaitoksen esikunta kilpailuttaa sotilasilmailukarttatuotannon. Tämä tarjouspyyntö koskee ilmailukarttatuotannon kilpailutusta. Sotilasilmailukartat ovat keskeinen sotilasilmailun lentotoimintaan liittyvän materiaalin osakokonaisuus. Sotilasilmailukarttojen kokonaisuus käsittää digitaalisten aineistojen ja painotiedostojen sarjan seuraavissa mittakaavoissa: 1:1.000.000 (digitaalinen tuote ja 2 painotiedostoa), 1:500.000 (digitaalinen tuote ja 8 painotiedostoa), 1:250.000 (digitaalinen tuote ja 17 painotiedostoa) ja 1:50.000 (vain digitaalinen tuote). Puolustusvoimissa sotilasilmailukartat päivitetään kerran vuodessa, yleensä huhtikuussa. Seuraava karttojen päivitys astuu voimaan 15.4.2027. Kukin karttatuote koostuu ajantasaisesta taustakartasta, jonka tietosisältö määrittyy mittakaavan mukaisesti sekä siinä esitettävästä ajantasaisesta ilmailutiedosta. Ajantasaisuus koskee taustakarttojen osalta erityisesti tiestöä ja ilmailutietojen osalta kulloinkin voimassa olevaa tai käyttöönottopäivänä voimaan tulevaa ilmailutietoa. Hankinta on aikataulullisesti erittäin tiukka. Sopimuksella tehtävä työ painottuu pienelle aikavälille kevättalvelle. Tämä saattaa aiheuttaa toimittajalle hetkellisesti paljon työtä, joka sijoittuu myös iltoihin, viikonloppuihin ja pyhien ajalle. Muuten taustakarttojen tietosisällön ja kuvausasun tulee soveltuvasti vastata tarkimpien mittakaavojen osalta tietosisällöltään Taktista karttaa (1:50k) sekä Operatiivista karttaa (1:250k). Ajantasaisuusvaade koskee myös yleisempien mittakaavaluokkien tuotteita 1:500k ja 1M mutta näillä tuotteilla ei ole varsinaisesti vastaavaa mittakaavaa Puolustusvoimilla käytössä. Hankinnan kohteen vaatimukset on kuvattu liitteessä 1 sotilasilmailukartat_tuotekuvaus. Tarkoituksena on tehdä kolmen vuoden sopimus. Lisäksi sopimukselle tulee yksi optiovuosi. Lisäksi hankinta pitää sisällään option ilmatilarakennetiedon tuottamisesta ja toimittajan on sitouduttava keskustelemaan tämän option toteuttamisesta. Sopimuksen toteuttaminen edellyttää aikaisempaa osaamista ilmailukarttatuotannosta. Tarjoajan on annettava referenssi tekemästään asiakastyöstä tai laadittava koetyö, jolla osoittaa osaamisensa ilmailukarttatuotannosta. Koetyöstä ei makseta erillistä korvausta. Koetyössä käytettävä ilmatilatietomateriaali pyydetään sähköpostilla 27.11.2026 lähtien osoitteesta geo.support@mil.fi. Sopimuksen arvioitu kokonaisarvo tulee olemaan noin 500.000€ alv 0% sisältäen optiovuoden, mutta ei optiota ilmatilarakennetiedon tuottamisesta. Hankinta ei pidä sisällään karttojen painatusta. Hankinnasta julkaistu markkinakartoitus: Ilmoituksen Hilma-numero: 2026-061539 Ilmoituksen TED-numero: 782121-2026

buyer: LHC Procurement Group for the Scottish Procurement Alliance (SPA)
title: Refurbishment and Modernisation (RM4S) - Scotland Framework Agreement
description: LHC Procurement Group Limited (LHCPG) is procuring the Refurbishment and Modernisation Scotland Framework Agreement (RM4S) on behalf of the Scottish Procurement Alliance (SPA). LHCPG is acting as the Contracting Authority and central purchasing body for this procurement. The Framework is being procured solely for use in Scotland and will provide eligible public sector organisations with a compliant and flexible route for the delivery of refurbishment, improvement, repair, maintenance and modernisation works, goods and associated services across residential and non-residential buildings. The procurement is being conducted using the Open Procedure in accordance with the Procurement Act 2023 and the Procurement Regulations 2024. When awarding Call-Off Contracts, eligible Clients and Partners must also comply with the Framework Agreement, the applicable Call-Off procedure and any other procurement legislation applicable to them. RM4S builds upon the existing Refurbishment and Modernisation Framework and has been developed following market engagement with suppliers and public sector organisations. Feedback received through that engagement has informed the scope, Workstreams, Lot structure, value bands and regional arrangements. The Framework comprises the following Workstreams and Lots: Painting and Decorating Electrical Works, from zero to 500k Electrical Works, 500k and above Kitchens and Bathrooms, from zero to 500k Kitchens and Bathrooms, 500k to 2m Kitchens and Bathrooms, 2m and above Aids and Adaptations Damp and Mould Remediation Environmental and External Works, External Works Environmental and External Works, Grounds Maintenance Stoneworks Reactive Repairs and Maintenance Multi-Disciplinary Works, from zero to 750k Multi-Disciplinary Works, 750k to 2.5m Multi-Disciplinary Works, 2.5m and above Kitchens (Supply only) The scope may include planned and reactive maintenance, refurbishment and improvement programmes, component replacement, compliance-led works, accessibility adaptations, environmental and external works, property modernisation and wider asset management and investment programmes. Each Lot is divided into five regional areas covering North Eastern Scotland, Highlands and Islands, Eastern Scotland, West Central Scotland and Southern Scotland. Bidders may apply for one or more Lots and regional areas in accordance with the Procurement Documents. Subject to there being sufficient Qualifying Bidders, LHCPG will appoint no more than 10 Appointed Companies for each Lot and regional area. Where a Micro and Small Enterprise Reserved Allocation applies, it forms part of, and is not additional to, the maximum of 10 appointments. The Framework will not operate a reserve list and no additional or replacement Bidders may be appointed during the Framework Term. The Framework is structured to support participation from organisations of different sizes and capabilities through its Workstreams, value bands, regional areas and applicable Micro and Small Enterprise Reserved Allocations. All Bidders will remain subject to the same published qualification, compliance, quality, evaluation and appointment requirements. RM4S is intended to support the delivery of high-quality and compliant solutions, sustainable supply chains, environmental improvement, social value, community benefits, Fair Work and proportionate innovation. Detailed technical requirements, eligibility provisions, award criteria, appointment methodology and Call-Off procedures are set out in the Procurement Documents.

title: CeTPD Laboratory Information Management System
description: The Centre for Targeted Protein Degradation (CeTPD) is an academic research center focused on translational chemical biology, currently housing ~60 researchers and technicians across disciplines and experience levels (undergraduate, post graduate students, post-docs, (senior) staff scientists, Principal Investigators). The requirement is a software solution, for all research staff, that provides Laboratory Information Management System (LIMs) capability. This broadly includes scientist electronic lab notebook (across disciplines), reagent inventory and management, compound inventory and management and ideally some capability for processed data databasing and rudimentary visualisation. We are seeking to procure a secure, cloud-based design and Laboratory Information Management System to support collaborative drug discovery workflows. The solution is expected to deliver; - An integrated platform for electronic lab notebooks, reagent inventory management, compound registration and management and ideally data visualisation. - The system must accommodate the needs of scientists in both chemical and biological sciences and their respective workflows. - The system must accommodate that Users may require access relevant to both chemical biological sciences workflows within the same user area. - Seamless integration with existing computational workflows - Seamless integration with third-party applications and/or databases - A secure, stable and scalable cloud deployment which Complies with the University and collaborator cybersecurity, information governance and GDPR requirements Meets with strict performance, reliability and governance standards Meets with the functional and non-functional requirements of the CeTPD (as outlined below) - Improved operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and scalability to support future growth and evolving scientific needs

title: Study on the Economic Impact of Sectoral Measures Contributing to Corruption Prevention
description: The EU Anti-Corruption Initiative in Ukraine (EUACI) seeks a consultant or team to study selected sectoral reforms in Ukraine, their economic effects and their additional benefits for corruption prevention. The study shall assess how reforms may reduce opportunities for corruption and develop indicative estimates of related savings and other economic benefits, using available data and explicit assumptions. The bidder shall propose one or several sectors and the measures to be examined. The final scope and methodology shall be agreed with the EUACI during the inception phase. The scope shall exclude the taxation and state regulation and control of the economy sectors covered by the separate EUACI-supported assessment and shall not repeat existing research. Methods may include desk review, interviews, focus groups, surveys and case studies. Assumptions, uncertainty and limitations shall be clearly stated. Deliverables include an inception report and methodology, draft and final study reports, a brief of up to four pages, a presentation, and reusable supporting data and calculations. The final report, brief and presentation shall be provided in Ukrainian and English. The findings shall be presented at one meeting organised by the EUACI. Applicants may be individual consultants or teams with relevant experience in governance, anti-corruption and impact assessment, including economic impact assessment. The research lead shall have relevant education at Master’s degree / academic level and have at least 10 years of relevant experience; the expert(s) responsible for sectoral analysis shall have at least five years of experience in the proposed sector(s). The consultant or relevant team members must be based in Ukraine for on-site research and stakeholder engagement and able to communicate directly with stakeholders in Ukrainian. An individual consultant shall meet all minimum requirements set out in the Terms of Reference. The assignment shall be completed within six calendar months from the date specified in the contract. The maximum total budget is EUR 70,000, covering all assignment costs and applicable taxes. Deadline for application 11 December 2026, at 14:00 Danish time Interested Consultants can request to get the instructions prepared for applicants by e-mail to the Contact person stated below Contact point EU Anti-Corruption Initiative in Ukraine (EUACI) Contact person Artur Karvatskyi Contact e-mail artkar@um.dk Criteria for selection A minimum of three and a maximum of five applicants with references best suited for the assignment will be invited to submit a tender.

title: Opparbeiding av urnelund ved Vestre gravlund - Ålesund
description: Ålesund kyrkjelege fellesråd innbyr med dette til open tilbodskonkurranse om kontrakt for opparbeiding av urnelund ved Vestre gravlund på Aspøya i Ålesund. Det skal etablerast totalt 688 urnegraver, 5 stk. minnetavler, port, hellelagt gangareal, bord, hellegang m.m. Dette er nærare beskreve i vedlagte prisforespørsel og teikningar. title: Kjøp av midlertidig mellomleder for Mattilsynets seksjon for produktutvikling
description: Anskaffelsens formål er å inngå kontrakt om kjøp av midlertidig fungerende mellomleder for Mattilsynets seksjon for produktutvikling. Seksjon produktutvikling sorterer under Avdeling Utvikling og består av følgende produktteam: Rollen vil ha ansvar for utvikling av Mattilsynets digitale produkter og tjenester, og produktteamene som leverer disse. Avdelingen arbeider med en leveransemodell basert på smidige, målstyrte og tverrfaglige produktteam, samtidig som man i perioden vil utforske mulighetene i produktområde-organisernig. For oppdraget kreves det ikke teknisk spesialkompetanse, men ressursen må kunne forstå teknologiske problemstillinger, stille relevante spørsmål og gjøre prioriteringer i dialog med teknologer og andre fagmiljøer. Mattilsynet har behov for en ressurs som: Raskt forstår organisasjon, herunder spesielt på avdelings- og seksjonsnivå, opdpraget og eksisterende arbeidsformer Kommuniserer tydelig og skaper tillit Evner å prioritere og skape og sikre fremdrift Skal lede kompetente og selvstendige medarbeider og fagmijøer på en tillitsbasert måte, samtidig som vedkommende skal være tydelig på retning og prioriteringer Utviser god rolleforståelse og skjønn i et tidsavgrenset lederoppdrag

description: La société Fret SNCF est une ancienne entreprise ferroviaire de transport de marchandises appartenant au Groupe SNCF, dont l’activité a pris fin le 31 décembre 2024. Devenue la Société Nationale d’Actifs de Transition (ci-après « la SNAT »), elle demeure, à ce jour, propriétaire d'un actif immobilier, dénommé Saint-Pierre-des-Corps, situé à la Ville-aux-Dames, identifié comme présentant un fort intérêt ferroviaire (ci-après le « Site ferroviaire »). Dans le cadre de la mise en œuvre d’un plan de discontinuité économique, la SNAT entend céder ce Site ferroviaire à un acquéreur intéressé. Le présent appel à manifestation d’intérêt a pour objet de procéder à la sélection dudit acquéreur. La localisation, les références cadastrales et les caractéristiques du Site ferroviaire sont indiquées dans les documents de la consultation. L’acquéreur sera sélectionné à l’issue de deux phases successives : (i.) une phase de candidature, dite également Phase 1, ouverte à tout Candidat respectant les conditions de participation prévues et (ii.) une phase d’offre, dite également Phase 2, réservée aux candidats admis à remettre une offre à l’issue de la phase de candidature. Les informations détaillées relatives à la procédure figurent dans le règlement de la consultation, accessible dans les mêmes conditions que les autres documents de la consultation (cf. rubrique « Informations complémentaires »). Le présent appel à manifestation d’intérêt, qui ne tend à la passation ni d’un marché public ni d’un contrat de concession, ne relève pas des directives 2014/23/UE, 2014/24/UE et 2014/25/UE du 26 février 2014. En outre, aucune disposition législative ou réglementaire ne subordonne la vente du Site ferroviaire à une procédure de publicité et de mise en concurrence préalable. La présente procédure est donc menée à titre libre et volontaire suivant les seules modalités décrites dans le règlement de la consultation.

title: Thermal Conductivity Measurement System
description: The National Research Council of Canada (NRC) requires the supply of a state-of-the-art thermophysical analysis system for the direct and simultaneous measurement of thermal conductivity (?), thermal diffusivity (a), and specific heat capacity (cp) for rechargeable battery systems and their constituent materials. The layered architecture of modern batteries introduces strong anisotropic heat transfer, with significant differences between in-plane and through-plane conduction. Conventional steady-state measurement techniques are often too slow or imprecise to capture these directional effects within intact cells. The required system must therefore use a transient thermal measurement methodology, such as the Transient Plane Source (TPS) or equivalent, to enable non-destructive and direction-resolved characterization of pouch, prismatic, and cylindrical cells. The new instrumentation will expand NRC’s Automotive and Surface Transportation (AST) sector capabilities by enabling precise measurement of both isotropic and anisotropic thermophysical properties under controlled temperature environments, ranging from sub-ambient to elevated conditions representative of real battery operation. These capabilities are essential for developing next-generation testing standards and modeling frameworks that address safety, cooling optimization, and lifecycle management in electric vehicle and stationary energy storage applications.

title: Wärmeverbund Utenberg Stadt Luzern
description:
Im Schulhaus Utenberg wird die Wärmeerzeugung erneuert. Neu werden die Häuser des Kinder- und Jugendheim 

Utenberg (KJU) über eine Fernleitung an die Technikzentrale Schulhaus Utenberg (SH) angeschlossen. Die beste-

hende Wärmeerzeugung wird durch eine Sole-Wasser Wärmepumpe ersetzt. 


 


5.1 HEIZUNGSANLAGE 

Die neue Wärmepumpe wird über ein Erdsondenfeld betrieben welches aus 40 Sonden à 300m besteht und in 

zwei Etappen realisiert wird. So kann der Betrieb auf dem Sportplatz weitergeführt werden. Die Erdsonden wer-

den auf zwei Verteiler zusammengefasst und in die Technikzentrale Schulhaus geführt. Von wo einerseits die 

Fernleitung zum KJU wegführt und dort ab der Fernwärmestation an das bestehende Netz angeschlossen wird. Im 

Schulhaus werden die Pufferspeicherkapazitäten erweitert und anschliessend auf den bestehenden Gruppenauf-

bau angeschlossen. Zur Betriebsoptimierung und der Regeneration des Erdreiches wird hinter dem Schulhausge-

bäude ein Rückwärmer aufgestellt. Dieser ermöglicht es in der Übergangszeit als Wärmequelle die Umgebungsluft 

zu nutzen, was zu einer Optimierung der Wärmepumpeneffizienz führt. 


 


5.2 LÜFTUNGSANLAGE 

Die Erdsondenwärmepumpe verfügt über das natürliche Kältemittel R290 (Propan), weshalb eine Sturmlüftung für 

den Havariefall notwendig ist. Die Sturmlüftung führt ab dem belüfteten Wärmepumpengehäuse über die alte 

Technikzentrale und den bestehenden Kamin über Dach. 


 


Die Technikraum wird mit einer Abluftanlage ausgestattet. Die Abluft wird im entsprechenden Raume abgesaugt 

und über ein Rohrnetz über die bestehende Kaminanlage über Dach abgeführt. Die Nachströmung der Luft erfolgt 

vom Lichtschacht über ein Gitter in den entsprechenden Raum.

Toimittajaksi valitaan tarjouspyynnön vaatimukset täyttävä tarjoaja, joka on tarjonnut kyseiselle osa-alueelle halvimman hinnan. title: Finland – Information and promotion products – Brändituotteiden ja sidosryhmälahjojen hankinta
description: Hankinnan kohteena on jakotuotteet, mainoslahjat ja liikelahjat tilaajalle. Hankinnan tavoitteena on löytää sopimuskumppaneita, joiden valikoimista löytyy kilpailutuksessa määriteltyjä tuotteita ja laajempi tuotetarjonta, josta tilaaja voi tehdä tilauksia joustavasti myös katalogituotteina kilpailutuksen ulkopuolisissa tarpeissa. Vantaan kaupunki on organisaatio, joka toimii monella eri toimialalla, ja siksi sen tekemisen, viestinnän ja palveluiden täytyy toimia erilaisissa tilanteissa ja eri kohderyhmille. Kilpailutuksessa valitaan määriteltyjä brändättyjä tuotteita valikoimaan (jakotuotteet, mainostuotteet ja liikelahjat) sekä mahdollistetaan eri palveluyksiköiden määrittää mainos- ja liikelahjatuotetarpeensa omista lähtökohdistaan. Yhteisenä nimittäjänä ovat kuitenkin Vantaan kaupungin arvot (avoimuus, kestävyys, rohkeus ja yhteisöllisyys). Tuotteiden tulee tukea Vantaan imagoa ja sopia sen toimintakulttuuriin ja arvoihin. Tuotteet voivat olla esimerkiksi yksittäisiä mainoslahjoja, kansainvälisille kumppaneille annettavia lahjoja, vierailuihin, tapahtumiin ja tilaisuuksiin liittyviä lahjoja tai messuilla ja yleisötapahtumissa käytettäviä massajakelutuotteita. Sopimuksen perusteella hankintoja voivat tehdä Vantaan kaupungin kaikki toimialat. Hankinnan kohteen tarkempi kuvaus tilattavasta palvelusta on kuvattu liitteessä 2 Hankinnan kohteen kuvaus. Hankinta on jaettu kahteen (2) eri osa-alueeseen: Osa-alue 1. Brändituotteet Osa-alue 2. Muut tuotteet a. Premium- ja Design-lahjat b. Kaikki muut valikoiman ulkopuoliset tuotteet Jokainen osa-alue vertaillaan erikseen. Tarjoaja voi tarjota kaikkia osa-alueita. Tarjoaja voi tehdä vain yhden tarjouksen per osa-alue. Vaihtoehtoiset tarjoukset eivät ole sallittuja. Tilaaja valitsee osa-alueelle 1 enintään yhden (1) sopimustoimittajan. Osa-alueelle 2 tilaaja valitsee enintään kolme (3) sopimustoimittajaa toimittajapooliin. Sopimuskausi on määräaikaisena voimassa kolme (3) vuotta. Tilaaja varaa oikeuden jatkaa sopimusta yhdellä (1) yhden (1) vuoden optiolla. Sopimuksen ehdot on kuvattu tarkemmin tarjouspyynnön liitteessä 1 Sopimusluonnos. title: DoW Office of the Assistant Secretary of War for Energy, Installations, and Environment: Acquisition Strategies for Munitions Storage Magazine Repairs and Recapitalization (MILCON and FSRM)
description: Description. This Request for Information (RFI) is issued solely for information and planning purposes and does not constitute a solicitation. All information received in response to this RFI marked Proprietary will be handled accordingly. Responses to the RFI will not be returned. Responses to this RFI are not offers and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. The Government does not intend to award a contract based on this RFI or reimburse any costs associated with the preparation of responses to this RFI. Overview. The Office of the Assistant Secretary of War for Energy, Installations, and Environment (OASW(EI&E)) is soliciting concepts, capabilities, technical insights and input from industry on acquisition strategies to efficiently execute large-scale repair, renovation, and recapitalization of munitions storage magazines (earth-covered magazines, above-ground magazines, subterranean magazines, and similar facilities) across the Army, Navy, Air Force, and Marine Corps using both Military Construction (MILCON) and Facility Sustainment, Restoration & Maintenance (FSRM) funding. The Department seeks scalable acquisition approaches on constrained timelines that can support a multi-year, multi-Service repair, modernization, and new construction campaign; leverage recent authorities such as Other Transaction Authority (OTA) and Progressive Design-Build; accommodate regional differences; and mitigate second- and third-order construction impacts that can arise from Explosives Safety Site Planning (ESSP) and Explosives Safety Board (ESB) reviews. The Government is interested in industry recommendations that support more aggressive timelines, improve schedule predictability, achieve economies of scale, and enable efficient prioritization and execution of high-impact work as better condition and capacity data become available. Background. The Department manages over 25,000 munitions storage magazines and will require additional magazines built to meet munition manufacturing production goals and delivery timelines. Many current magazines require significant repair or modernization. Repair includes structural degradation and other items required to ensure a magazine is useable for its original purpose, while modernization is meant to ensure a magazine has the capability to meet modern munitions requirements (e.g. larger door size, addition of climate control, cranes, etc.). Preliminary assessments indicate a substantial multi-billion-dollar backlog spanning MILCON and FSRM. The Department currently lacks a comprehensive, authoritative picture of capacity, condition, and prioritization across the enterprise. Ongoing assessment efforts are actively improving this data. Disclaimer: This is a Request for Information (RFI) issued solely for market research and strategic planning. This does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP), nor does it obligate the Office of the Secretary of War or OASW(EI&E) to fund or contract for any submitted concepts.

title: DLA DWCF B1907 Backup Power Generator, Yokosuka, Japan
description: Introduction: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Japan District (POJ), is performing market research for an upcoming Design-Bid-Build (DBB) requirement entitled, �DLA DWCF B1907 Backup Power Generator, Yokosuka, Japan.". This announcement represents a market survey that is intended for planning purposes only. The purpose of this notice is to identify sources capable of performing this project and to receive responses from those firms to assist the Government's acquisition planning. This survey does not constitute a commitment by the Government for any follow-on announcements, solicitation, or award. This notice is NOT a solicitation. The Government will not pay for any information provided as a result of this market survey. This market survey is intended for local sources only. Local sources are those sources physically located and licensed to conduct business in Japan. Firms interested and capable of performing this work are highly encouraged to submit a response (submission requirements are located within this notice). We are committed to partnering with industry as much as we can throughout this process and therefore encourage all interested companies to respond to this sources sought. Market research and industry feedback is an essential part of the acquisition process. The information requested in this announcement will be used within POJ to facilitate decision-making and will not be disclosed outside the agency. However, respondents submitting business information pursuant to this announcement should consult 41 C.F.R. parts 105-60 and other implementing regulations concerning the release of such information to third parties under the Freedom of Information Act (FOIA). All information submitted by respondents that they consider confidential and not releasable to third parties outside of USACE, and its employees, agents, consultants, and representatives, must be clearly and conspicuously marked. SYSTEM FOR AWARD MANAGEMENT (SAM) All interested companies, including joint ventures, shall be registered in the SAM database in order to be eligible for award of Government contracts. https://www.sam.gov LOCAL SOURCES Firms which have not done business with U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Japan Engineering District, are requested to visit the following website: https://www.poj.usace.army.mil/Business-With-Us/ for general information. This contract will be performed in its entirety in the country of Japan and is intended only for local sources. Only local sources will be considered under this solicitation. Local sources are sources (e.g. corporations, partnerships, or Joint Ventures [For a Joint Venture, the Joint Venture as an independent entity must satisfy the local source requirements or, in the alternative, each member of the Joint Venture must individually satisfy the local source requirements]) that are physically located in Japan and authorized (i.e. licensed and registered) to perform construction in Japan. Specifically, a prospective offeror must be duly authorized to operate and conduct construction business in Japan and must fully comply with all applicable laws, decrees, labor standards, and regulations of Japan during the performance of the resulting contracts. In addition, offerors must possess a Japanese civil construction (doboku isshiki koji) license or Japanese architectural construction (kenchiku isshiki koji) license by the proposal due date and time. The U.S. Government will verify that the offeror has the license through the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (MLIT) website at https://etsuran2.mlit.go.jp/TAKKEN. It is the responsibility of the offeror to ensure that it has the license (Japanese civil construction or Japanese architectural construction), and that it is accurately shown on the MLIT website, by the proposal due date and time. Failure to comply with this requirement will be cause for rejection of your offer. The U.S. Government will not offer �United States Official Contractor� status under Article XIV of the US-Japan Status of Forces Agreement (SOFA) to U.S. contractors normally resident in the United States; nor will the U.S. Government certify employees of such contractors as �Members of the Civilian Component� under Article I(b) of the SOFA. PROJECTS INFORMATION: Project Title: DLA DWCF B1907 Backup Power Generator Project Location: Yokosuka Japan Project FSC: Y1MZ - Construction of EPG (Electric Power Generation) Facilities�Other, Including Transmission Project NAICS: 237130 - Power and Communication Line and Related Structures Construction Project Magnitude: Between �500,000,000 and �2,000,000,000 (Japanese YEN) Project Description: Design-Bid-Build. Install a backup generator to support the mission at Building 1907. The new backup generator is expected to provide backup power to B1907 for the next 10 years at minimum. The generator has been sized to handle the following planned future loads: five new VLMs assumed to be rated the same as the existing VLMs(total of ~45 kW), operation of all four existing conveyor elevators (currently only two are operational at this time; two conveyors are fed from a 200A @ 210V, 3ph/3w feed), and an expected 20% increase in loads for the server rooms (total of ~20 kW). Anticipated Period of Performance: 518 Calendar Days Procurement Method: The Government intends to issue an Invitation for Bid (IFB) Solicitation. The Government anticipates that a solicitation will be issued approximately in May 2027. This survey does not constitute a commitment by the Government for any follow-on announcements, solicitation(s), or award(s). Any solicitation(s) pursued will be intended for local sources only. Local sources are those sources physically located and authorized to perform construction work in Japan. Draft plans and specifications are being provided for INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES. Offerors are cautioned that these drawings and specifications are in DRAFT FORMAT. ========================================================================== REQUESTED INFORMATION Interested firms are requested to reply with the following information no later than 11 December 2026 Japan Standard Time. Please submit your responses via e-mail to Mr. Ryan Marzetta, Contracting Officer at ryan.j.marzetta@usace.army.mil and Mr. Jiro Miyairi, Contract Specialist at jiro.miyairi@usace.army.mil Name of your company, address, phone number, email, SAM UEI, CAGE Code, and English Speaking Point of Contact (POC) name. Please provide at least one (1) project, but no more than three (3) projects, that is comparable to this project your company has completed (for government or commercial customers) in the past six (6) years. a. Project Title and Location b. Customer/Agency c. Project Value and Brief Description d. Date Completed or Percent Complete e. title: Generator Inspection & Maintenance Services, various locations, Nunavut
description: Description: The Royal Canadian Mounted Police in Iqaluit, Nunavut Territories, has a requirement for Generator Inspection & Maintenance Services at the RCMP Cambridge Bay, Clyde River, Gjoa Haven, Kinngait, Qikitarjuaq, Taloyoak Detachments, Iqaluit Headquarters Building and Iqaluit Hangar. This procurement is subject to the Nunavut Land Claims Agreement and the Directive on Government Contracts, Including Real Property Leases, in the Nunavut Settlement Area. Bidders are requested to maximize Inuit employment, subcontracting and on-the-job training opportunities, and involve Inuit businesses, in carrying out the work under this project. The Nunavut Agreement contains a provision requiring the inclusion of socio-economic bid criteria in the solicitation document, when practicable and consistent with sound procurement management principles. These socio-economic bid criteria are referred to as Nunavut Benefits Criteria (NBC) and Inuit Benefits Criteria (IBC), and bidders propose Inuit benefits in their bid submission via an Inuit Benefits Plan (IBP). This solicitation is limited for bidding among firms registered on the Inuit Firm Registry (IFR). Bids submitted by businesses not on the IFR will render the bid non-responsive and no further consideration will be accorded to the bid. Delivery Date: The contract period will be for 36-months from the date of contract, with the option to extend for 2 additional 1 year periods. Security: This requirement contains a security requirement. Basis of selection: A bid must comply with all the requirements of the bid solicitation and meet all mandatory requirements. Bids not meeting the requirements will be declared non-responsive. The selection will be based on the highest responsive combined rating of total Inuit Benefits Plan (IBP) merit, and price. The ratio will be 30% for the total IBP merit, and 70% for price. Tenders must be submitted to the RCMP Bid Receiving Unit at: NWR_Procurement_Bids@rcmp-grc.gc.ca Refer to the attached tender documents to obtain further information. Canada retains the right to negotiate with any supplier on any procurement. Documents may be submitted in either official language of Canada. The RCMP has adopted the Integrity Regime administered by Public Services and Procurement Canada. As a result, the integrity provisions are being applied in RCMP contracting activities as outlined in this solicitation. Canada will make available Notices of Proposed Procurement (NPP), bid solicitations and related documents for download through the Government Electronic Tendering Service (GETS) at https://canadabuys.canada.ca/en/tender-opportunities . Canada is not responsible and will not assume any liabilities whatsoever for the information found on websites of third parties. In the event an NPP, bid solicitation or related documentation would be amended, Canada will not be sending notifications. Canada will post all amendments, including significant enquiries received and their replies, using GETS. It is the sole responsibility of the Bidder to regularly consult GETS for the most up-to-date information. Canada will not be liable for any oversight on the Bidder's part nor for notification services offered by a third party. Indigenous Procurement: The federal Indigenous Business Directory (IBD) is an online resource for all levels of government and the private sector to identify Indigenous business capacity. Having a business profile in the IBD will increase your company’s visibility and may provide additional business. A profile in the IBD can also allow you to compete for federal government contracts that are set-aside for Indigenous businesses through the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Businesses. For more information and to review eligibility criteria and register, visit: www.canada.ca/indigenousbusinessdirectory.

title: RFI Review of Medical Tort Claims
description: The Federal Bureau of Prisons (BOP) requires independent, professional medical review and analysis services in support of administrative tort claims alleging medical negligence or malpractice associated with medical care provided to individuals in BOP custody. The contractor shall provice qualified medical specialist to conduct objective evaluations of medical records, assess the applicable standards of care, identify potential deviations from those standards, evaluate medical causation and resulting injuries, and prepare comprehensive written medical opinions. Services shall be preformed on an as needed basis in response to individual case assignments issued by authorized Government personnel. Vendors should carefully review the SOW before submitting a response. The Government is seeking capability information from firms that can directly perform and support the full scope of services. Responses that do not address the firm's ability to meet the requirements outlined in the SOW may be considered less useful for market research purposes. THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION FOR PROPOSALS OR QUOTATIONS. This Sources Sought Notice is issued solely for market research purposes in accordance with FAR Part 10. The Government is conducting market research to identify qualified contractors capable of providing review of medical tort claims. The purpose of this notice is to determine the availability of capable small business concerns, including socioeconomic small business categories, and to assist the Government in developing an appropriate acquisition strategy and potential set-aside determination. Responses to this notice are voluntary and shall not be considered offers. The Government does not intend to award a contract on the basis of this Sources Sought Notice and will not reimburse respondents for any costs associated with preparing or submitting a response. Interested vendors are requested to provide: Company name and address UEI number Business size and socioeconomic status Relevant NAICS code(s) SAM.gov registration status Description of experience reviewing medical tort claims Any recommended contract structure or acquisition considerations The Government may use information received in response to this notice for acquisition planning purposes only. Participation in this market research effort is not a prerequisite for participation in any future solicitation.

title: F999--INTENT TO SOLE SOURCE-SHORT TERM-SDS Chemical-Environmental Consulting Services
description: **NOTICE OF INTENT TO SOLE SOURCE** This is a Notice of Intent to Sole Source published in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) RFO 5.101(a) Presolicitation notice requirements and (FAR) RFO 12.102 Restricting Competition. This Notice of Intent is for a proposed award of an open market sole source award to C.J. SETO Support Services, LLC for 3 month service contract for the VHA SDS/Chemical Inventory system of approximately >110K active SDSs in the VHA unique catalog; providing direct access to over 10M vendor SDSs; maintenance of the VHA worksite hierarchy with >20K locations; and >650K chemical inventory associations. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this service is 541620 (Environmental Consulting Services). Product Service Code (PSC) is F999 Other Environmental Services, Small business size standard is $19.0 Million. While this synopsis does not constitute a solicitation, interested vendors may identify their interest and capability to satisfy the requirement. All responsible sources may submit a capability statement, which shall be considered by the agency, by emailing such statement and supporting documentation by NLT 10:00 AM Eastern Standard Time (EST), 12/11/2026 to Contract Specialist Charles Willis via email at Charles.willis@va.gov. Please reference the announcement number (36C24527Q0087) in the subject line of the e-mail. Such documentation will be reviewed solely for the purpose of determining whether or not to conduct the procurement on a competitive basis. A determination not to compete this requirement, based upon responses to this notice, is solely within the discretion of the Government under authorities cited above. Safety Data Sheet (SDS)/Chemical Inventory Service Statement of Work I. INTRODUCTION The Veterans Health Administration (VHA), Assistant Under Secretary for Health, Facilities and Requirements and Oversite (FRO) is a program office that currently has a subscription system/service using a contractor resource that has been in place since 2008, and VHA directed for field use since 2012 to comply with Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) 29CFR1910.1200. The resource is the enterprise solution for all VHA and all VA Medical Centers (VAMCs) compliance with OSHA 29CFR1910.1200, VHA Directive 7705, VA 0057, and other associated directives. In unison with FRO, the contractor maintains and manages the VHA SDS/Chemical Inventory system of approximately >110K active SDSs in the VHA unique catalog; providing direct access to over 10M vendor SDSs; maintenance of the VHA worksite hierarchy with >20K locations; and >650K chemical inventory associations. This system is accessible via the Intranet by all VHA locations/facilities/staff. The SDSs are indexed with value added fields and reviewed and updated regularly. Discontinued and obsolete SDSs are archived and inventory history and back up features can be used to maintain records as needed. VHA currently serves all VHA locations/facilities and staff that benefit by maintaining the current system as the means to provide current SDS information and chemical inventories for all VHA locations/facilities II. DELIVERABLES The vendor will provide the following functions for the VHA to achieve the greatest efficiency and cost effectiveness: Provide a VHA unique SDS catalog (>110K); facility chemical (hazardous material) inventory associations (>650K); >20K site specific locations/site structure; >5K service administrators; and all VHA users (~300K) that will inherently and seamlessly capture 100% current system data/information and technical/functional requirements that s transparent to VHA users. Require no service configuration or present any service degradation. The system/service shall reside on the vendor s systems and be accessible to VHA through an intuitive, browser-based user interface. The vendor must demonstrate they maintain >99% server availability and full network redundancy to ensure the highest levels of reliability. Provide a single VHA unique repository of current and archived electronic SDSs; update them at least tri-annually for the most current version; ability to view SDSs in multiple languages and formats; and make them readily accessible electronically to all VHA locations/facilities. Provide access to the application for FRO personnel and all other VHA personnel to provide role-based presentation: from simple read-only access to sophisticated configurations for administration and inventory management. Ability to have at least 5 levels of administration (administrator, national, regional, local, and site specific) and limit location/facility inventories from other locations/facilities. Provide an auto-generated VA ID# for each SDS indexed in the VHA system (catalog). Provide Unit of Measure data for each VHA cataloged SDS. Provide ability for users to create backup electronic or paper copies of VHA locations/facilities SDSs and chemical inventories by location, facility, or department. Provide the functionality within the system for the assignment of SDSs to departments, locations/facilities and the ability to develop chemical inventories, at all organizational levels. Provide the VHA with the means to create archived records of inventories. Provide a system that is fully compliant with the OSHA Globally Harmonized System (GHS) to produce SDSs and associated labels. Provide live assistance (via helpdesk and toll-free phone number) 24-7-365 (during FRO non-business hours, 5:00PM-7:00AM CT) that will provide VHA staff access to all SDSs and assistance with exposures and spills. Provide capability to be alerted when a newer version of an SDS in their inventory is available. Alert should clearly identify the change to the SDS. Provide a revision alert module that enables users to track SDS changes. The module provides users with email notifications when there are changes to certain data points between a new SDS and the prior version. Provide capability for a chemicals/products approval process; to support logistics management and control of chemicals/products entering the location/facility. Capability must provide designated staff with routine notifications when new chemicals/products will be added to location/facility/site/department inventory. Provide capability to upload inventory volume/quantity information and produce reports that list ingredients of any product/mixture. Provide capability to access complete inventory information including but not limited to snapshots of statistics, inventory history and a report showing current inventory (by location, by product, by CAS RN, etc). Provide capability to monitor activity within a specific location. Reports should have flexibility to track by date, specific administrator, specific task performed and be compiled and available in different formats for manipulation by user. Provide ability to compare chemicals/products in the VHA catalog or location/facility inventory against similar products to analyze components and evaluate for greener products in the vendor s entire SDS catalog. Provide capability for locations to develop safety cards using location/facility inventory data maintained in the system catalog/inventory. Provide capability to link VHA SDS catalog and location/facility inventories to waste classification codes for products in inventory; to assist with identification and classification of hazardous waste. Provide capability to generate regulatory (federal and state) reports by location/site, product or CAS #. Provide capability to produce customizable labels for local use (i.e. secondary containers). title: Ireland – Event services – Establishment of a Single Party Framework Agreement for the Provision, Production, Event Management and Delivery for Road Safety Roadshow for Donegal County Council
description: Donegal County Council invites tenders for the establishment of a Single Party Framework Agreement for the provision of production, event management and delivery services for the Road Safety Roadshow. The Road Safety Roadshow is an annual road safety education and awareness initiative aimed primarily at senior post primary school students. The event seeks to increase awareness of road safety risks, promote responsible road user behaviour and encourage safer attitudes and decision-making among young people. The Framework Agreement will provide for the planning, creative development, production, coordination, management and delivery of the annual Road Safety Roadshow. This will include the development of engaging and impactful educational content, technical and production requirements, the coordination and management of contributors and participating stakeholders, event logistics, staffing and on-site event management. The Roadshow is designed to incorporate a range of educational and interactive elements, including video content, live presentations and contributions from emergency services personnel and individuals sharing their lived experiences. The production shall also include theatrical and staged elements, including the use of actors’ and demonstrations to illustrate a road traffic collision scenario supporting the overall delivery and impact of the Roadshow. The successful tenderer will be required to work closely with Donegal County Council and road safety stakeholders to develop and deliver professional, engaging and impactful events that meets the objectives of the initiative and appropriate for its target audience. The agreement is intended to facilitate the delivery of the annual Road Safety Roadshow events over its duration, subject to the terms and conditions of the Single Party Framework Agreement.

description: Amendment 002: This amendment provides responses to questions received, corrections to several solicitation documents, and provides new contacts for the receipt of proposals. The response sue date and time are not extended. The following documents are amended and previous versions deleted: C05a_1a EOTW G-Z LTIRSC_12363N26R4016_A002 C05b_1b EOTW G-Z LTIRSC SOI_12363N26R4016_A002 C05c_2 EOTW G-Z LTIRSC Appendix A_A002 C05d_3 EOTW G-Z LTIRSC Appendix B_A002 C05e_4 EOTW G-Z LTIRSC Appendix C_A002 Proposals are to be submitted via email to Bonnie Yoakum at bonnie.yoakum@usda.gov and Kasandra Meyer at kasandra.meyer@usda.gov. Amendment 001: This amendment provides responses to questions received, updates the points of contact for proposal submission, extends the solicitation response due date and time to 9:00 AM MST on 12/11/2026 and sets a deadline of 11/13/2026 for additional questions. This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in FAR Part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Proposals are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number 12363N26R4016 is issued as a Request for Proposal (RFP) for the End of the World G-Z Long-Term IRSC (EOTW G-Z LTIRSC). The End of the World Project area is approximately 50,000 acres on the Salmon River Ranger District of the Nez Perce-Clearwater National Forest. The End of the World EIS authorizes commercial treatment on over 17,000 acres primarily through intermediate harvest. The purpose of the EOTW G-Z LTIRSC is to thin overstocked stands to reduce the risk of catastrophic wildfire as well as improve stand health. The EOTW Project is within the Wildland Urban Interface and has numerous private inholdings with seasonal and permanent residents. This contracting tool will increase the pace and scale of active management beyond the current capacity of staffing levels. A secondary objective of the EOTW G-Z LTIRSC is to provide a steady, dependable supply of timber and forest products to local facilities. This project aligns with Secretarial Memo 1078-006 and the Implementation of Secretarial Memo 1078-006 dated April 3, 2025 to utilize long term stewardship contracts for active management. This acquisition is not set-aside for small business concerns. The applicable North American Industry Classification Standard Code is 113310 and the small business size standard is 500 Employees This acquisition is an unrestricted requirement. All responsible sources may submit a proposal and offer which will be considered by the agency.

description: The U.S. Mission Geneva seeks qualified companies to provide gardening services to one of its official residences. The anticipated period of performance is a base year with four one-year options, if exercise by the government. The Government intends to award a contract resulting from this solicitation to the lowest priced technically acceptable offeror. Your proposal must be submitted electronically to genevaProcurement2@state.gov. In order for a quotation to be considered, you must also complete and submit the following : 1. SF-33 2. Section B, Pricing 3. Section K Representations and Certifications 4. Additional information as required in Section L 5. Proof of SAM Registration The U.S. Mission intends to conduct a pre-proposal conference at the site. The pre-proposal conference will be held on November 25th, 2026, at 2:00 pm (local time) at the MSG residence located in Bellevue Switzerland. Prospective offerors/quoters should contact Danielle Suberlucq Suberlucqdc@state.gov before November 23th COB for additional information or to arrange entry to the building.

title: Gutter Cleaning and Maintenance Services
description: Procure Gutter Cleaning and Maintenance Services in support of Naval Weapons Station (NWS) Earle. Services are to be performed at Colts Neck and Leonardo, New Jersey.
